title: Alleged CJNG Member Linked to Decapitation Killing Arrested in Ecatepec, State of Mexico
detail: On September 21, 2026, Mexican Navy (SEMAR) personnel from the Central Naval Region, working with the Ecatepec Task Force, municipal police and the State of Mexico Attorney General's Office (FGJEM), arrested Irving Hernández Nonato, 38, in the Colonia Panorámica neighborhood of Ecatepec, State of Mexico. Authorities identified him as an alleged CJNG member and a violence generator in Valley of Mexico municipalities, wanted on an active warrant for qualified homicide tied to a case in which the victim was killed and decapitated, with an intimidating message left at the scene. He was further linked by investigators to organized crime, extortion (including a 'gota a gota' predatory lending scheme), drug trafficking, and trafficking/stockpiling of weapons reserved for the exclusive use of the Armed Forces.

media.caption: Irving Hernández Nonato, alleged CJNG member, detained by Semar in Ecatepec, State of Mexico

confidenceReason: The arrest, location and outstanding homicide warrant are confirmed by Semar and corroborated by two independent Tier-2 outlets; his precise CJNG rank and the full extent of the extortion/trafficking allegations remain prosecutorial claims pending trial.
